analysis: Worked from the version-6 text. (1) POL-NS-12 conditions all hold on EV-TRIP-04061: arrival_marker GPS_AUTO; PLATFORM_TELEMETRY driver_arrived 13:06:00 stating distance (16 m) and speed (0 km/h); wait_timer_started 13:06:05 and wait_timer_expired 13:10:05; expiry precedes the 13:14:10 termination. Contradiction test on EV-GPS-04061 (admissible, weight 0.3, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE x PARTIAL_RECORD x UNVERIFIED_SOURCE): the only fixes inside 13:06:00-13:14:10 are 13:06:20 (5.6 m), 13:09:30 (17.8 m), 13:12:40 (8.0 m), all 0 km/h; 13:02:50 (825.5 m, 22 km/h) is before the window and 13:14:50 (260.7 m, 30 km/h) is 40 s after the cancellation. So arrival is established at 13:06:00 and the free wait served. (2) POL-NS-01: (a) event present; (b)/(c) via NS-12; threshold 360 s reached 13:12:00 and cancellation 13:14:10 is after it (490 s from arrival; 470 s even from the first export fix); (d) no boarding, CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER, RIDER_NO_SHOW. (3) No displacement: NS-02's 'no qualifying in-radius fix' is not proof of absence because null-accuracy fixes are neither counted nor excluded (integrity note) and NS-02's notes send a too-sparse trace to NS-08(b), while NS-12 supplies the arrival for a GPS_AUTO marker; NS-03 not engaged (inside 120 m); NS-04(a) fails (no RIDER message in EV-CHAT-04061) and (b) fails (two driver in-app calls), NS-11 makes the empty rider_track neutral; NS-05 not engaged; NS-06 no shortfall, MISSING EV-ADVIS-04061-01 not relied on; NS-10 not engaged (driver cancelled, on-demand). (4) Integrity: NS-08(b) impairs the export (in-window intervals 190/190 s > 120, 3 fixes < 6) but it is not the only evidence for the deciding fact - EV-TRIP-04061 at 1.0 carries it independently and is not impaired under (a)-(d) (arrival event vs nearest fix 20 s; termination vs last fix 40 s); NS-08(c) not engaged (chat 4 = chat_message_count 4, sequential, the interval containing 13:06:00 is 135 s; the 475 s gap 13:06:15-13:14:10 does not span the marker); NS-08(d) ledger 8.81 = gross. So NS-08's closing sentence and NS-09(e) do not fire. GEN-02(2) cap = max(1.0, 0.3) = 1.0 >= 0.70. NS-09(b) no artifact-to-artifact contradiction (the rider's statement is a party statement); (c) 0 + 0 < 2; (d) anti-farming 1 (< 4) and 1/97 = 0.0103 (<= 0.08), rider no_show_disputes_30d 0. (5) POL-NS-07: 0.80 x net 6.00 = 4.80; DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd = driver_compensation_sgd = 4.80 (POL-GEN-03); referrals []. The only reader difference is reader b's REVERSAL, which fails because no party's story is contradicted by the record (see differences). No ambiguity in ruling, money, referrals or clauses that a careful reader could resolve differently: both blind readers reach the key's ruling, amounts, referrals and core clauses. Observation only (no action on the case): build/blueprint_ns.json's chat admissibility note says the largest interval is 330 s, while the shipped case file correctly says 475 s (13:06:15 to 13:14:10); the case file is right and the key does not depend on it.
